parents.name: LiveBench 2.0
parents.focus: Contamination-free, long-horizon work (coding, research, browser use)

rows.name: Browser
rows.focus: multi-step tasks in working web applications, completed through a real browser. Scored as the share of tasks passed. A model that cannot accept screenshots cannot do these tasks and scores 0.
rows.metrics: quality, cost, time, tokens, effort, breakdown, other
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Browser Use — 0-100 suite score, mean task score over the suite's 25 tasks (share of tasks passed); column 'browser' in table.csv, also the table's first column when the suite is selected (?cats=Browser) · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/table.csv
Cost [page]: Cost per successful task — USD, (Σ cost ÷ Σ tasks ÷ score) × 100 over the selected suite; table column plus 'Quality vs. cost · Browser Use' and 'Cost, ranked · Browser Use' charts · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.0
rows.notes: JS page (hash route; ?cats=<suite> selects the suite and sorts by it, per main.js); values from release 20261106 data files the page loads. Default view: one row per model, finetunes hidden. Weight in Overall per categories.json: 1.0.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L3 (Advanced); bootstrap agreement: L3 78%, L4 22%.
Placed from 64 models' published scores.
Best observed: GPT-6.1 Terra (max) 100.0, Claude Fable 5.1 (max) 100.0, Claude Opus 4.8 (max) 96.0.

rows.name: Data Aggregation
rows.focus: Exhaustive traversal of a large record set and multi-part roll-ups.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Data Aggregation — 0-100 subcategory score = mean score over its 6 tasks; shown as a column when the Browser Use suite is selected (?cats=Browser) and in each model's expanded row · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/breakdown.json
Effort [page]: Effort: — one entry per model at its highest supported effort (name carries a lower setting, e.g. 'Claude Fable 5.2 (xhigh)'); inherited from the parent model entry, no separate rows per effort · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aa
rows.notes: Subcategory of Browser (6 tasks) shown in the suite breakdown; no own URL, link is the parent suite view. Values from breakdown.json (release 20261106).
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L3 (Advanced); bootstrap agreement: L3 66%, L4 34%.
Placed from 64 models' published scores.
Best observed: GPT-6.1 Terra (max) 100.0, GPT-6.1 Sol (max) 100.0, Claude Fable 5.1 (max) 100.0.
Data caveats: Only 6 tasks -> very coarse (scores jump in steps; many 0/100 ties). LiveBench 2.0 values change between releases (tasks rotate, single run per model, unmeasurable tasks score 0); our DB (63 models) does not match release 20261106 alone (e.g. DB Long Agentic Claude Opus 5.5 (max) 85

rows.metrics_detail:
